correctness.rationale: Both branches strictly increasing force alternating cross-branch primitive-two points. A right-inverse scalar reduction gives a differentiable D with at most two stationary points for any d!=1, hence at most three roots. Four exact alternating evaluations prove three roots at the displayed rational witness; no-fixed-point inequalities and the sign-multiplier identity prove two repellers and one sink. Endpoint convention and d=1 countercase are explicit. Auxiliary standalone checks reproduced numerical roots and rational sign identities.
risks: The proof addresses period two only, not higher-period recurrent dynamics.
